objective: Preserve generous public-safe intake, atomic evidence, calibrated claims, correction readiness, selective projection, and maintainable provenance without automatic publication.

criteria.criterion: Every canonical and operator intake has a stable ID, visibility, status, disposition, and safe forward path.
Sources preserve provenance, public-use boundaries, rights state, and opaque protected locators without exposing protected URLs.
Source readings decompose evidence into atomic assertions with confidence and explicit limitations.
Candidate, promotion, rejection, hold, and canonical claim states remain internally consistent.
Jamie's role, collective accomplishment, institutional action, use, outcome, transfer, and causality remain distinct.
Contradictions, corrections, negative evidence, limitations, and unresolved questions remain traversable.
Editorial selection remains independent from evidence maturity and reversible by surface.
Archive-population claims expose retrieval limits, deletion uncertainty, denominator gaps, and survivorship bias.
Visual discovery creates research leads while rights, consent, caption, and evidentiary use remain separate.
Maintenance reports expose stale reviews, duplicate IDs, orphaned records, unresolved holds, and projection drift.
